description: Write a cover letter for a specific job from the user's résumé. Uses one unit of the monthly cover-letter allowance. Takes 30–120 seconds. Returns the letter text — refine it with the user in conversation rather than regenerating. If one already exists for this job it is returned without spending allowance.

force.description: Regenerate even if a result already exists, or if the match score is low. Spends allowance. Only set this when the user asks.

resume_id.description: Which stored résumé to use. Omit to use the default. Call list_my_resumes to see the options.

name: write_cover_letter
title: Write a cover letter
